# MesloLGS Nerd Font Mono

Terminal's default face: four faces of Meslo LG S (André Berg's customisation
of Apple's Menlo, itself from Bitstream Vera Sans Mono) patched by Nerd Fonts
with the Powerline symbols and icon sets that prompts like Powerlevel10k draw.
"Mono" is Nerd Fonts' strictly fixed-pitch build: every icon fits one cell.

Source: the Nerd Fonts v3.5.1 release archive `Meslo.tar.xz`
(https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/download/v3.5.1/Meslo.tar.xz),
unmodified. `README.nerd-fonts.md` and `LICENSE.txt` are the archive's own.

Licence: the Meslo outlines are Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE.txt`); the icon
sets Nerd Fonts adds carry their own licences, listed in
`README.nerd-fonts.md`. The image installs this notice as
`/system/licenses/meslo-nerd-font.txt`; tools/embkfs_mkfs/fonts.py installs
the faces as `/system/fonts/meslo-nf-mono*.ttf` on both architectures.
